item.title: Connecting applications to a shared PostgreSQL and learning basic maintenance. Part 2
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: The second part of the series on a shared PostgreSQL for a home server. We create a dedicated, minimally privileged user and database in pgAdmin for a specific application, connect Authentik to the shared database instead of its own container, and cover basic maintenance - VACUUM, ANALYZE, REINDEX, and when you actually need to do any of this by hand.

item.title: Setting up PostgreSQL and pgAdmin in Docker with Docker Compose for beginners. Part 1
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to installing and configuring PostgreSQL on a server. Covers installation steps, creating users and databases, setting up backups, and basic security for stable and reliable operation.
